items.title: Pay ergotherapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Period runs 'binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum' (within 21 days after the invoice date). Invoice date: 18.11.2026. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (invoice date) is not counted, so the 21-day period starts on 19.11.2026 and the 21st day is 09.12.2026 (18.11.2026 + 21 days = 09.12.2026). This is a private payment deadline, so under §193 BGB it would move only if the last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday. 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NW, so no adjustment is needed.
